details:
Players should have the option to display their current world name on their profile while inside Group, Invite, or Invite+ instances.

This could be a simple personal setting called "Show Private World on Profile."

Off (Default): Private world locations remain hidden as usual.

On: Friends can see the world name while the player is in a private instance, but cannot join unless the instance's existing permissions allow it.

Players using Orange (Ask Me) or Red (Do Not Disturb) would still have their locations hidden.

Only the world name would be displayed, not the instance ID, player count, or other occupants.

This could also benefit events and VRChat groups by allowing players to voluntarily show where activities are taking place, helping promote gatherings without making private instances publicly accessible.

The goal is to give players more control over their visibility without changing how private instances work.
title: Allow Players to Voluntarily Display Their World in Private Instances
